channel.title: Making of Iltonggi
channel.description: How Iltonggi is being made — one short note a day.

item.title: Gwansanseong, 554: Where an Alliance Ended
item.description: Three years after the 551 Han River scenario, the Baekje-Silla alliance broke at Gwansanseong. Here is that scene, and where Iltonggi's diplomacy rules touch it.

item.title: Keeping Direct Command From Becoming a Cheat: Balancing It by Computer
item.description: How we keep Direct Command in Iltonggi from becoming a cheat by balancing it with simulated battles, why its rules stay simple, and what is still left to do.

item.title: The 551 Han River Contest: Unnamed Generals Become "General ○○"
item.description: Building Iltonggi's 551 Han River scenario: dropping out-of-era generals, placing Kim Mu-ryeok and the Daegaya king, and why unknown names stay "General ○○."

item.title: Four Kingdoms, Four Colors, Still Distinct at Night
item.description: How we picked colors for Goguryeo, Baekje, Silla and Gaya in Iltonggi, measured whether they stay distinct day and night, and added hanja chips and shapes too.

item.title: A Three Kingdoms Land Grab for Your Phone
item.description: Why we're building Iltonggi, a Three Kingdoms land-grab game for your phone: 5-10 minute rounds, autosave, a short first game, and no daily log-in pressure.
